content.text:
The robot found the red ball, walked up to it and stopped about 20–25 cm away. I then called rest.

Facing is only approximate. Before rest, the ball was just below the camera view, slightly to the right, and I turned about 9° right to face it. The crouch itself also moved the heading by roughly 9°, and in the last image the ball sits at the bottom edge, so I couldn't confirm it is dead ahead.

There were no falls or obstacles.
